title: Figure 20: Roadmap to Aneutronic Fusion Propulsion Development (2000-2060)
description: Gantt-style timeline chart with blue bars spanning 2000 to 2060. Phases shown in sequence are 'PHYSICS DEMO' (about 2010-2030), 'Tech Development' (about 2020-2045), 'Ground DEMO' (about 2033-2048), 'FLIGHT DEMO' (about 2045-2055) and 'MANNED MISSION' (about 2055-2060).
